topic.title: Hybrid CPU Architecture

body.p: The processor is built on hybrid core architecture, which includes both P-cores and E-cores in a single package for optimizing different workload requirements. All P-cores and E-cores within in the package will share the same last level cache and have identical CPUID signature, therefore, single microcode update will apply.
